title: Shame about the gap around the spoon and the jar
text: Shame about the gap around the spoon and the jar. I ended up returning this item, which I really didn’t want to...is because there is a gap around the spoon, which could led to flies coming in.  Unfortunately, we don’t live in a vacuum, and fruit flies etc have the smelling abilities to survive.  Otherwise, this would have been a keeper if there were a rubber sealant.
